title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕ Friday, September 4, 2026

🌤️ Weather — Warm end-of-summer day; high near 83°F, low ~67°F, mostly dry with a slim afternoon shower chance. Light layers; sunglasses over an umbrella.

🗞️ Headlines
• Food-safety oversight rollbacks ripple through the supply chain — CA lettuce growers plowing crops under amid weak demand.
• Trump administration + AI industry push back on data-center backlash.
• Medical groups issue updated flu/COVID vaccine guidance amid mixed messaging.
• CDC–Pennsylvania feud escalates over measles response.

🚇 Getting around — Labor Day weekend work: G line skips 4 Av–9 St, 15 St–Prospect Park & Fort Hamilton Pkwy (Church Av-bound) from 10:45pm through Tuesday. A line loses Rockaway Blvd ↔ Lefferts Blvd from Sat. Sunday schedule Monday for the holiday.

🎉 NYC today — Lily Allen at MSG (8pm). Sylvan Esso DJ set at Elsewhere (10pm) or the Doors tribute at Brooklyn Bowl.

💡 Nugget — Unofficial last weekend of summer; cheap last-minute NYC hotel/Broadway deals as tourism winds down.
